g.text: Signal to order (AI trend filter on)
The AI's picture is taken BEFORE the signal marker is drawn. The order is placed only after the model's answer, at the price of that moment.
PNG in memory: the AI's input, no marker on it
the marker appears only after the picture
reads the current Ask/Bid, then the existing checks:
open position, stop / target, sizing, broker
AFTER the entry, with the marker:
After the signal, the marker is drawn and OrderExecutor.TryEnter
is called at once. No picture is taken for the AI and no request
is sent: the steps in the other two lanes do not exist.
Why the order of steps 1 and 2 matters
A model that sees the strategy's own BUY / SELL marker is nudged
towards the answer the strategy hopes for. The marker is still
drawn for every signal, whatever the AI decides.
